verdict.rationale: Codex ships `$skill-installer`, a skill the agent runs inside Codex to install curated skills by name or from a GitHub directory URL. Skills are also auto-discovered from `.agents/skills` directories, so an agent could place one there itself. `codex plugin marketplace add` gives a CLI path for adding a marketplace source. However, nothing documents these paths as promptless or headless end to end. Plugin install goes through the interactive `/plugins` browser, needs a new session before use, and a plugin may prompt you to connect an external service. Missing for 10: explicit non-interactive/headless install mode (e.g., a scripted CLI install command or a flag to skip confirmation), plugin install without the interactive browser or session restart, and hands-on corroboration of an unattended agent-driven install.
